data.storageGuidance: Store at 40%–60% state of charge in a dry room (10 °C – 25 °C)
data.serviceabilityLevel: External fuse & latch user-serviceable; internal cells sealed
safetyNotes: Use only the matched 36 V / 42.0 V charger model DB-CHG-4A.
Never open, puncture, crush, or submerge the sealed battery enclosure.
Stop charging immediately if casing cracks, swelling, or unusual heat appear.

materials.material: Polyamide PA6-GF30 end caps & frame latch

repairView.safetySummary: Only external parts (Fuse and Latch) are user-serviceable. Internal lithium cell and BMS components require an authorised workshop.

hotspots.label: External Discharge Fuse
repairSteps: Switch off the e-bike and remove the battery pack from the downtube.
Lift the recessed rubber service flap beside the lower discharge connector.
Pull the 30 A mini-blade fuse straight out using insulated tweezers.
Seat the new fuse until flush and press the IP65 rubber flap firmly closed.

sparePart.name: 30 A Mini-Blade Discharge Fuse
sparePart.placeholderNote: Placeholder spare-part SKU for concept demo only

hotspots.label: Frame Lock & Latch
repairSteps: Place the detached pack on a clean padded surface with the lock nose accessible.
Unscrew the two external M4 bracket bolts holding the worn latch carrier.
Fit the replacement latch assembly without loosening any main housing seam bolts.
Tighten both M4 bolts to 2.5 Nm and check spring return before mounting.

recycling.takeBackInstruction: Never place e-bike batteries in household trash or curbside bins. Return spent DB-36V packs free of charge to any participating Demo Brand bicycle dealer or municipal lithium-battery collection point.
prepSteps: Cover exposed discharge terminals with insulating electrical tape before transport.
Keep the outer casing intact — do not crush, incinerate, or open the battery pack.
If the casing is dented, leaking, or warm, place it in a non-conductive container and alert drop-off staff.
